lines.text: One hundred thousand yuan.
The school rejected the application because the budget was too high.
Was it rejected?
How did you know?
Director Wang always uses the same line: a clear academic value report is missing.
So do I apply again, or give up?
There is a third way.
If the school will not pay, we find money outside.
What is the price?
They want their logo on the materials and their name in the report.
I cannot make a presentation.
I only write code and solder circuits.
Then I will help you.
When did you arrange this?
After you sent me the coordinate data last night.
I joined this project to integrate resources and negotiate.
You need me, just as I need your technology.
Are you coming, or do you not want the direction finder?
Hengyuan Education Technology looked like a futuristic palace.
What can this project bring to Hengyuan?
Hengyuan is selling exploration and technology-empowered education this year.
If Hengyuan becomes the exclusive sponsor, we can promise three things.
Jiang Che will give a speech at the national science competition.
A speech?
His personal story is the best brand narrative.
Legal department, change the deposit clause to forty percent.
Happy cooperation.
We will pay forty thousand yuan as the deposit first.
Forty thousand yuan is enough for your direction finder.
Is it true that I will speak at the national competition?
If the project goes well, why not?
But what?
The final payment of sixty thousand yuan may disappear.
Director Chen wants a return.
Our story, your face, and Antarctica's signal are all commodities.
I understand.
The terms changed three days later.
This is an unfair clause.
You are minors, so the letter of intent has no legal force without guardian signatures.
They tricked us from the very beginning.
What about the forty thousand yuan?
Is there no other way?
The chance of finding another sponsor in one month was almost zero.
Jiang Che found his parents' Antarctica expedition diary.
We decided to bury a signal transmitter under the Antarctic ice.
It is not for military or commercial purposes, but as a mirror for the future.
Stars never shine alone.
He suddenly knew what to do.
I found our funding, but not from a company.
What do you mean?
These are my parents' notes from their Antarctic research.
Do you want to sell them?
No. I want to make an exhibition.
I made an interactive light installation with the scanned maps.
How much will it cost?
About three thousand yuan in materials.
Where will the income come from?
A charity sale.
You forgot one key problem: promotion.
That is why I need you.
I handle technology and content; you bring the audience through the door.
Good, but I have one condition.
The exhibition needs a stronger title.
Waiting for You at the End of the World.
Good.
The opening day was unusually clear.
Thank you for supporting Project Polaris.
How did you make the floor respond?
I used Arduino and pressure sensors under the floor.
By three p.m., more than one thousand visitors had entered the gallery.
Because stars never shine alone.
Twenty-eight thousand four hundred yuan.
It is enough to buy the direction finder.
Thank you.
One person may fail, but two people may find a way.
Do not thank me too early.
I contacted the National Antarctic Expedition Office.
When did you contact them?
The night before the exhibition opened.
We need a backup plan.
You are scary.
Scary enough to make people want to stand beside you.
